scope: Synthetic local component and command proofs; no full TS-01 acceptance or real rendered PDF evidence.
notes: 19 original boundary cases completed before a slow aggregate run was stopped. The final positive name selector executes only the remaining 9. No assertion or repository deadline was changed.

One attempted resumption used an unsupported skip flag and executed no tests; another negative selector matched the parent suite, repeated existing cases and was stopped. Neither contributes additional coverage.

The single Finance OUT-14 bytes.length > 1000 failure is reproduced unchanged on main with the same synthetic-byte helper. The assertion remains intact; real PDF rendering and browser/restart suites are left to CI.
Initial B4 tests were followed by targeted reruns after strengthening the assertions; repeated tests are not counted as new coverage.
